To choose 3 items from a set of 7, we use the combination formula:

\[
\binom{7}{3} = \frac{7!}{3!\,(7-3)!} = \frac{7!}{3!\,4!}
\]

Simplify:

\[
\frac{7 \times 6 \times 5 \times 4!}{3! \times 4!} = \frac{7 \times 6 \times 5}{3 \times 2 \times 1} = \frac{210}{6} = 35
\]

So there are 35 distinct ways to choose 3 items from 7.

ANSWER: 35
